event_text: World War I: Romania signs a secret treaty with the Entente Powers. According to the treaty, Romania agreed to join the war on the Allied side.
headline: Romania Enters World War I with Secret Treaty
story: Barry gazed out at the diplomats scurrying about below, adjusting their gloves. 'Seems Romania's decided to throw its hat into the ring, Susan. August 1916, and they've just signed a secret treaty with the Entente Powers – France, Britain, Italy, and Russia. Romania's agreed to declare war on Austria-Hungary and the Central Powers in exchange for some rather enticing territorial promises.' Susan cocked her head, preening a feather. 'The Allies are offering them a substantial chunk of Transylvania, plus bits of Bukovina and the Banat. Quite the land grab, if you ask me.' Barry snorted. 'And all they have to do is take on the might of the Austro-Hungarian army. Should be a stroll in the park, really. I mean, what could possibly go wrong?' Susan shot him a wry glance. 'One does wonder if they've considered the, ah, minor detail of actually winning the war.'
regret_line: Apparently, the Romanians forgot to read the fine print on the whole "war" thing.
winner_line: The war machine itself, as the influx of new troops and resources only served to prolong the bloody conflict.
